rationale: Study54 halfway Romanian development has99.1%recall but13.6%formal false reviews. Test direct binary review supervision jointly with six semantic objectives.
warm_start: Study54 development-selected encoder and auxiliary heads; study22 binary classifier/pooler. No checkpoint is selected using calibration.

training.loss: Binary cross-entropy plus mean of six categorical cross-entropies.
training.sampling: Equal mass over six training source/class groups.

selection: Initial,halfway,final development checkpoints: unchanged99%recall/5%false-review gates, then worst and total false review rates, auxiliary field loss, earlier step. Numerical gap>=1e-4 without excluding required positives.
inference: Existing NativeReviewModel binary head. Auxiliary semantic heads regularize training and are separately reported; they do not supply a claimed calibrated risk score.
evaluation: Persist selection before regression calibration. Actual installed full DEV/CAL CPU replay; reserved63only if both languages qualify.
